description: This file implements the core functions for managing Open Content Decryption Module (OpenCDM) systems and sessions, including creation, destruction, session management, and querying capabilities. It interacts with external components such as ActiveSessions, Logger, and MediaKeysCapabilitiesBackend, and provides an API for handling DRM sessions and keys.

classes.name: OpenCDMSystem
classes.description: Represents an OpenCDM system instance, managing DRM capabilities and sessions.

classes.name: OpenCDMSession
classes.description: Represents a DRM session, handling key exchange, status, and data exchange.

methods.name: opencdm_create_system
methods.description: Creates a new OpenCDM system instance based on the provided key system string.

methods.name: opencdm_create_system_extended
methods.description: Creates a new OpenCDM system with extended parameters.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_system
methods.description: Destroys an existing OpenCDM system instance.

methods.name: opencdm_is_type_supported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system and MIME type are supported.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the specified system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the specified system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_drm_time
methods.description: Gets the DRM time from the system.

methods.name: opencdm_get_system_session
methods.description: Retrieves a session associated with a key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_system_set_server_certificate
methods.description: Sets the server certificate for the system.

methods.name: opencdm_get_session
methods.description: Retrieves a session for a given key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_construct_session
methods.description: Constructs a new DRM session with specified parameters.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_session
methods.description: Destroys a DRM session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_load
methods.description: Loads a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata from a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_id
methods.description: Returns the session ID.

methods.name: opencdm_session_buffer_id
methods.description: Returns the buffer ID for the session (not implemented).

methods.name: opencdm_session_has_key_id
methods.description: Checks if the session contains a specific key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_session_status
methods.description: Returns the status of a key within the session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_error
methods.description: Returns the last error code for the session (not implemented).

methods.name: opencdm_session_system_error
methods.description: Retrieves the system error for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_update
methods.description: Updates the session with a license message.

methods.name: opencdm_session_remove
methods.description: Removes a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_resetoutputprotection
methods.description: Resets output protection (not implemented).

methods.name: opencdm_session_set_parameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter for the session (not implemented).

methods.name: opencdm_session_close
methods.description: Closes a session.
